description: **`--new-session` names what used to be the absence of two other flags.** Which session `miniclaude repl` runs is now one selection over `--resume <id>`, `--continue-session` and `--new-session`; passing none of the three still starts a new session, so every command line that worked before works unchanged. Passing two is refused by name -- `--resume` and `--continue-session` are mutually exclusive -- and the refusal covers every pair rather than the one the code happened to check.

**`--help` states each flag's presence, and `--permission-mode` explains its six modes.** Every flag now renders `[required]` or `[optional]` instead of leaving it to the help text to say so, and the permission modes render as a block with a line of help each. `--seed ""` on `miniclaude mock` is a value now rather than a request for a random seed, so it is refused instead of silently ignored; omit the flag to get a random one.
